g.text: The gauging graph: two edges between every vertex pair

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #657487

g.text: Each numbered line bundles TWO edges. Each edge has its own gauge qubit Aq; crossings are not vertices.
